summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Nigel Griffiths, covering his education. It states he attended Hawick High School in the Scottish Borders, earned an MA from the University of Edinburgh in 1977, and completed training at Moray House College of Education in 1978. It also notes he led the University of Edinburgh Labour Group in 1976, when he first supported Gordon Brown, then the student Rector.
one_line: Biographical note on Nigel Griffiths's education in Scotland and his 1976 role leading the University of Edinburgh Labour Group.
key_facts: Nigel Griffiths was educated at Hawick High School in the Scottish Borders.
Nigel Griffiths attended the University of Edinburgh, where he was awarded an MA in 1977.
Nigel Griffiths finished his education at Moray House College of Education in Edinburgh in 1978.
Moray House College of Education is now the Moray House School of Education on "Holyrood Road" at the University of Edinburgh.
Nigel Griffiths was president of the University of Edinburgh Labour Group in 1976.
Nigel Griffiths first met and supported Gordon Brown while serving as president of the University of Edinburgh Labour Group in 1976.
Gordon Brown was the student elected Rector of the University of Edinburgh at the time of 1976.
